behaviours.quote: to aid you in combat, occupying 3
behaviours.observe_source: Cost(500335) = 3 exceeds the reference Life Force 2, so the gate learns Summoning Adept 92123 (Effect[2] SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS +1 on Life Force 805011, Capacity() 3) between the phases. No cast before (control): no Abomination; one Raise: Abomination after: one 50068.

behaviours.name: Raise: Abomination (Life Force)
behaviours.quote: occupying 3
behaviours.observe_source: Summoning Adept 92123 learned at the start (Capacity 3). Before the raise (control) 3 free Life Force; after one Raise: Abomination none: it occupies all 3.

behaviours.name: Raise: Abomination (attack speed)
behaviours.quote: and reducing their attack speed by
behaviours.observe_source: Disease Cloud 578319 (aura 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE -20%, 15000 ms) on the dummy after the Abomination fought it for 7000 ms (Command: Undead 504868 at the dummy; its cloud 802353 pulses every 3000 ms in combat, UpdateAI event 2). Control: no Abomination, no aura. Summoning Adept 92123 is learned (the setup learns) so the cost 3 fits.

behaviours.name: Raise: Abomination (Command)
behaviours.quote: Instantly unleashes an empowered disease cloud around it.
behaviours.observe_source: npc_ascension_necromancer::DoAction, case 50068: the Command makes the Abomination cast Zombie Plague 504022 on itself with the amount of 504022 Effect[0] plus 505223 Effect[1] (Copy), a cloud around it. Control: no Abomination, no 504022 hit; one Command after a raise: one 504022 hit on the dummy at 3 yd.

behaviours.name: Raise: Decaying Colossus (raised)
behaviours.quote: to aid you in combat, occupying 3
behaviours.observe_source: Cost(500989) = 3, so the gate learns Summoning Adept 92123 (Capacity 3) between the phases. No cast before (control): none; one Raise: Decaying Colossus after: one 50115.

behaviours.name: Raise: Decaying Colossus (Life Force)
behaviours.quote: occupying 3
behaviours.observe_source: Summoning Adept 92123 learned at the start (Capacity 3): 3 free Life Force before the raise (control), none after one Raise: Decaying Colossus.

behaviours.name: Raise: Decaying Colossus (Command)
behaviours.quote: Unleash a powerful attack dealing Weapon Damage
behaviours.observe_source: npc_ascension_necromancer::DoAction, case 50115: the Command schedules event 5 3000 ms later, which casts Command: Bone Smash 505229 (Effect[0] NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG and Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE 100, cone 104) at the commanded target. The read counts the Colossus 50115 casts of 505229 (SMSG_SPELL_GO), not its hits: a NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG spell can be dodged or parried by the dummy, a combat roll the claim does not state. Control: no Colossus, no cast; after a raise one cast.

behaviours.name: Raise: Decaying Colossus (damage split)
behaviours.quote: of all damage taken by the caster is taken by the
behaviours.observe_source: Decaying Colossus Passive 520376 Effect[0] 143 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER, aura 81 SPELL_AURA_SPLIT_DAMAGE_PCT 25 ($520376s1 = 25): with the Colossus up the caster takes 75% of a hit. A stationary striker casts Light of the Naaru 41394 (Holy, fixed amount) at the caster: control without a Colossus, treatment after one real Raise: Decaying Colossus (Summoning Adept 92123 learned for Capacity 3). Expected treatment / control = 0.75.

behaviours.name: Raise: Abomination (disease cloud)
behaviours.quote: Nature damage to enemies
behaviours.observe_source: npc_ascension_necromancer::UpdateAI event 2 (every 3000 ms): an Abomination 50068 in combat casts Disease Cloud 802353 (SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Nature, enemies within 10 yd, SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT) on itself. The Command sends it into combat with the dummy at 3 yd. The control commands without an Abomination and must count no 802353 hit. 823764 on the caster removes partial resists of its minion's spell (GetSpellModOwner), so the hit is modelled unresisted. Summoning Adept 92123 gives the Life Force 3 an Abomination needs.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (first giant)
behaviours.quote: Rotting Frost Giant
behaviours.observe_source: Army of the North 561138 (3000 ms cast) applies its aura; the contract makes Effect[0] a PERIODIC_DUMMY every 3000 ms (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp, periodic(0, 3000)) and each tick calls Summon(player, 561316) (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp), one Rotting Frost Giant 51275 per NecromancerSummons row {561316, 0, 51275, 1} ($561316s1 = 1). No cast (control): none; 561138 carries SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so the first tick comes when the aura applies: 300 ms after the cast ends one giant.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (before the second tick)
behaviours.quote: repeating every
behaviours.observe_source: The same cast read 2700 ms after the cast ends, before the 3000 ms period ends: still the one giant of the initial tick.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (second tick)
behaviours.quote: repeating every
behaviours.observe_source: 3300 ms after the cast ends, past the 3000 ms period ($t1): the repeat has brought a second giant (2700 ms after the cast end there is one), so the repeat comes every 3000 ms.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (all giants)
behaviours.quote: repeating every
behaviours.observe_source: 561138 DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms, $d) and the 3000 ms period ($t1): the initial tick (SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD) and 15000 / 3000 = 5 repeats, one giant each, all alive (30000 ms lifetime). Read 15800 ms after the cast ends: 6 giants.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (Runic Power)
behaviours.quote: Runic Power,
behaviours.observe_source: $/10;561317s1 = 30 Runic Power shown, 300 in internal units (561317 EffectBasePoints[0] 299 + 1). Each tick EnergizeBySpell(player, 561138, 300, POWER_RUNIC_POWER) (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp); the caster logs the energize. No cast (control): 0; the initial tick, read 300 ms after the cast ends: 300.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (no tick after the duration)
behaviours.quote: repeating every
behaviours.observe_source: Upper bound of $d = 15000 ms: read 18800 ms after the cast ends, past the 18000 ms tick an 18 s or longer aura would make: still the 6 giants of 0, 3, ..., 15000 ms (each lives 30000 ms), no seventh.

behaviours.observe_source: Blocked Ghoul swings under the army (pet_melee_blocked, HITINFO_BLOCK): the stock roll puts block before crit (Unit.cpp:3495-3510), so a blocked swing would be a non-critical hit; read 0, so a block is not what gives the plain hit of the reproduction (progress.md C1).

behaviours.name: Army of the North (aura applied)
behaviours.quote: For the duration
behaviours.observe_source: The army's aura 561138 on the caster 300 ms after its 3000 ms cast ends: present, so it covers every Ghoul swing of the crit entries (the Ghoul is raised after the army). Control: no cast, absent.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (aura army_held)
behaviours.quote: For the duration
behaviours.observe_source: The army's own aura 561138 on the caster (the aura the crit hook reads, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp OnBeforeRollMeleeOutcomeAgainst), read 17700 ms after the cast starts (3000 ms cast, $d = 15000 ms): present. Control: no cast, absent.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (aura army_ends)
behaviours.quote: For the duration
behaviours.observe_source: The army's own aura 561138 on the caster (the aura the crit hook reads, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp OnBeforeRollMeleeOutcomeAgainst), read 18300 ms after the cast starts (3000 ms cast, $d = 15000 ms): gone. Control: no cast, absent.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (giant lifetime held)
behaviours.quote: to aid you in combat for
behaviours.observe_source: $561316d = 30000 ms (561316 DurationIndex 9), the giant lifetime (Summon passes the spell duration to SummonCreature as a timed despawn). Giants come at 0, 3000, ..., 15000 ms after the cast ends (initial tick, then every 3000 ms); 3300 ms after the cast end two are up, and 29400 ms later (29700 ms after the second giant came) the five from 3000 ms on are alive: the 0 ms giant has gone at 30000 ms.

behaviours.name: Army of the North (giant lifetime ends)
behaviours.quote: to aid you in combat for
behaviours.observe_source: As the held read, but 30100 ms after the two-giant read (30400 ms after the second giant came): it has despawned at 30000 ms, four remain.

behaviours.name: Raise: Ghoul (auto attack heal, more Intellect)

Without the coefficient row both arms read the same heal.

behaviours.quote: and Lichfrost applies 2 stacks.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:106-107: the caster's own damage from a Lichfrost spell (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 0x8000000, Lichfrost 801722 rank 1) with 92121 known calls Plague(player, target, 2), which adds 2 stacks of Crypt Plague 570131 (AscensionNecromancer.cpp:262-272). One Lichfrost 801722 hit on the dummy (its direct damage Effect[0]; Effect[2] is a slow, no damage) reads 570131 stacks by the caster 2500 ms after the cast starts (1500 ms cast time, CastingTimeIndex 16, plus its 30 yd/s missile): 0 without 92121 (control), 2 with it. 570131 lasts 10 s (DurationIndex 1), so the 12 s wait clears the control's state.

behaviours.name: Crypt Plague (Crypt Swarm)
behaviours.quote: Damage dealt by Crypt Swarm now applies 1 stack of Crypt Plague
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:106-107: each damage of Crypt Swarm 800343 by the caster with 92121 known calls Plague(player, target, 1). Crypt Swarm rank 8 501886 (BaseLevel 54, the level-60 rank) is a 3000 ms channel (DurationIndex 27) whose Effect[0] aura 227 triggers 800343 every 500 ms: 6 hits, so 6 stacks of 570131 (StackAmount 10, below the cap) 3600 ms after the cast with 92121, 0 without it (control).
